solution_summary: For the tightly regulated financial services industry, staying compliant with regulations is a constant challenge. The compliance team at Parameta , a division of global markets and data solutions provider TP ICAP , spent hours manually reviewing the Benchmarks Regulation and assessing whether its products and documentation were up to par. Using Amazon Bedrock, Parameta developed a solution that uses generative AI to automate the compliance review process. Using Amazon Bedrock, the solution compares documents automatically to assess compliance. By improving its compliance review process, Parameta can now launch new services to clients at a fast pace. With the support of the AWS prototyping team, the company developed the solution in 3 weeks.
